name: CircleCI
description: CircleCI is a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform that lets teams build, test, and deploy software automatically, with cloud, self-hosted runner, and on-premise Server deployment options.
best_for: Built for developers, platform engineers, and engineering managers at organizations of any size, from startups to enterprises, who need fast, reliable pipelines across mobile, AI/ML, and traditional software projects.
features: Configurable pipelines via YAML with parallelism and custom job workflows
Test splitting and intelligent test insights to speed up CI runs
Self-hosted runners for building on your own infrastructure
Automatic rollback pipelines for failed releases
Build caching and dependency caching to cut pipeline time
Integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, AWS, GCP, and Azure

alternatives.name: Jenkins
alternatives.description: An open source automation server with a vast plugin ecosystem for building custom CI/CD pipelines.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want full control over a self-hosted, highly customizable CI/CD server.

alternatives.name: GitHub
alternatives.description: A developer platform for hosting code and automating workflows via GitHub Actions.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want CI/CD built directly into the same platform that hosts their code.

alternatives.name: GitLab
alternatives.description: An end-to-end DevSecOps platform spanning planning through deployment and security.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting one consolidated platform for source control and CI/CD.
